label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — user input flows from getParameterMap() through doSomething() to bar, into SQL query, then results from DB query are toString()'d and printed to response; while encodeForHTML is applied, the resolved sink value depends on attacker-controlled data retrieved from the injected query. Alert 2 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — user input param flows directly into SQL string at line 56 without parameterization; resolved sink value is sql = "SELECT..." + bar + "", where bar = param from user input. Both alerts demonstrate attacker-controlled data reaching sensitive expressions.

evidence.note: User input extracted from request.getParameterMap() into param variable
doSomething() returns param unchanged as bar
SQL injection: bar (user input) concatenated directly into SQL query string
XSS sink: results.toString() (containing queried data from user-injected query) printed to response
